campaign.title: The Trophy That Walked
campaign.finale: Case solved! Laia’s robot carried a fake cup. Chidi saved the real trophy from water. Ms Diop hid a party message in its speaker. Your clues made sense when you shared them. Tell your team: which surprise was the best?

chapters.title: 1. A Duck Took It?
chapters.intro: The school trophy is missing! A camera saw a giant duck carrying a cup. Where did it go? Look at your picture. Tell your team. Answer together.
chapters.recap: The trophy is missing. A duck carried a cup away. Follow the picture clues.
chapters.ending: You found the duck in the library. Surprise: it is Laia’s ROBOT! Nobody is inside. Laia says, “Wait… that cup is not the school trophy!”

objectives.text: Where did the duck go? Ask the Picture checker and Place checker. Write the place.

help.ca: On ha anat l’ànec? Pregunta al Picture checker i al Place checker. Escriu el lloc.

objectives.text: Who uses the duck? Ask the Message checker and People checker. Match the code. Write the name.

help.ca: Qui fa servir l’ànec? Pregunta al Message checker i al People checker. Compara el codi. Escriu el nom.

objectives.text: Ask in Team chat: “What did you see?” Then write together: “The duck went to… It belongs to…”

help.ca: Pregunta al xat d’equip: «Què has vist?» Després escriviu junts: «L’ànec ha anat a… És de…»

objectives.successCriteria: Two short statements: the duck went to the library and belongs to/is used by Laia. Accept simple English. Do not require robot mechanics, fake trophy, or later story facts.

discoveries.text: An empty trophy stand. A sign says: “School trophy.” Where has it gone?

help.ca: Un suport buit. Un rètol diu: «Trofeu de l’institut». On ha anat?

discoveries.text: You hear “QUACK!” behind the library door. Tell your team what you heard.

help.ca: Sents «QUAC!» darrere la porta de la biblioteca. Explica al teu equip què has sentit.

reveals.text: Picture checker: describe the door sign. Place checker: say which place uses that sign.

help.ca: Picture checker: descriu el rètol de la porta. Place checker: digues quin lloc té aquest rètol.

reveals.text: Message checker: say the code. People checker: find that code on your list.

help.ca: Message checker: digues el codi. People checker: busca aquest codi a la teva llista.

chapters.title: 2. Two Trophies!
chapters.intro: The duck is Laia’s robot. She says its cup is fake. Which cup is real? Who moved it? Look at your picture. Tell your team. Answer together.
chapters.recap: Laia controls the duck robot. Its cup may be a copy. Compare the badges.
chapters.ending: Two cups! The duck carried a cardboard copy. Chidi moved the REAL trophy at 9:00—before the duck arrived. Why?

objectives.text: Which badge is on the real trophy? Ask the Picture checker and Message checker. Write the shape.

help.ca: Quin símbol té el trofeu autèntic? Pregunta al Picture checker i al Message checker. Escriu la forma.

objectives.text: Who moved the real trophy? Ask the People checker and Place checker. Match the clothes. Write the name.

help.ca: Qui ha mogut el trofeu autèntic? Pregunta al People checker i al Place checker. Compara la roba. Escriu el nom.

objectives.text: Ask in Team chat: “Are the cups the same?” Then write together: “One has… The other has… We think…”

help.ca: Pregunta al xat d’equip: «Les copes són iguals?» Després escriviu junts: «Una té… L’altra té… Pensem…»

objectives.successCriteria: Compare the round badge on the duck’s cup with the star badge on the real school trophy. Conclude they are different cups/the duck has a copy. Simple sentences are enough. Do not require knowing why Chidi moved the real trophy.

discoveries.text: Laia: “I made a cardboard cup for my robot show. I did not take the real trophy.”

help.ca: La Laia: «Vaig fer una copa de cartró per a l’espectacle del robot. No vaig agafar el trofeu autèntic».

discoveries.text: Two camera times: someone moved a trophy at 9:00. The duck arrived at 9:05. Which happened first?

help.ca: Dues hores de la càmera: algú va moure un trofeu a les 9:00. L’ànec va arribar a les 9:05. Què va passar primer?

reveals.text: Describe the badge: “Mine is round.” “Mine is a star.” Are these the same cup?

help.ca: Descriviu el símbol: «El meu és rodó». «El meu és una estrella». És la mateixa copa?

reveals.text: People checker: say the colour. Place checker: say who wears that colour.

help.ca: People checker: digues el color. Place checker: digues qui porta aquest color.

roleClues.picture-checker: The duck’s cup has a ROUND badge. Compare it with the school trophy record.
roleClues.message-checker: School trophy record: the REAL trophy has a STAR badge.
roleClues.people-checker: Camera, 9:00: someone in GREEN lifts the STAR trophy. You cannot see their face.
roleClues.place-checker: Today’s clothes: Laia wears purple. Chidi wears a green hoodie. Ms Diop wears blue.

endingImage.alt: The duck’s open hatch shows a battery and gears. Beside it, a torn cup with a round badge reveals cardboard.

intro.ca: L’ànec és el robot de la Laia. Diu que la seva copa és falsa. Quina copa és l’autèntica? Qui l’ha mogut? Mira la teva imatge. Explica-la al teu equip. Responeu junts.

recap.ca: La Laia controla el robot ànec. Potser la copa és una còpia. Compareu els símbols.

ending.ca: Dues copes! L’ànec portava una còpia de cartró. En Chidi va moure el trofeu AUTÈNTIC a les 9:00, abans que arribés l’ànec. Per què?

picture-checker.ca: La copa de l’ànec té un símbol RODÓ. Compara-la amb la fitxa del trofeu de l’institut.

message-checker.ca: Fitxa del trofeu de l’institut: el trofeu AUTÈNTIC té una ESTRELLA.

people-checker.ca: Càmera, 9:00: algú vestit de VERD agafa el trofeu amb l’ESTRELLA. No se li veu la cara.

place-checker.ca: Roba d’avui: la Laia va de lila. En Chidi porta una dessuadora verda. La senyora Diop va de blau.

picture-checker.alt: The duck’s cup has a ROUND badge. Compare it with the school trophy record.

message-checker.alt: School trophy record: the REAL trophy has a STAR badge.

place-checker.alt: Today’s clothes: Laia wears purple. Chidi wears a green hoodie. Ms Diop wears blue.

chapters.title: 3. A Thief—or a Helper?
chapters.intro: Chidi moved the real trophy. Did he steal it or help? Find where it went and why. Look at your picture. Tell your team. Answer together.
chapters.recap: The duck’s cup was fake. Chidi moved the real trophy before the duck arrived.
chapters.ending: Chidi SAVED the trophy from a leak! It is safe in the blue box at first aid. Then the trophy speaks: “Find the SUN.” A talking trophy?!

objectives.text: Where is the real trophy? Ask the People checker and Place checker. Match the sign. Write the room.

help.ca: On és el trofeu autèntic? Pregunta al People checker i al Place checker. Compara el rètol. Escriu la sala.

objectives.text: Why move the trophy? Ask the Picture checker and Message checker. What was falling onto it?

help.ca: Per què cal moure el trofeu? Pregunta al Picture checker i al Message checker. Què li queia a sobre?

objectives.text: Ask in Team chat: “Was Chidi helping?” Then write together: “Chidi moved it because… It is safe in…”

help.ca: Pregunta al xat d’equip: «En Chidi estava ajudant?» Després escriviu junts: «En Chidi l’ha mogut perquè… És segur a…»

objectives.successCriteria: Explain that Chidi moved the trophy to protect it from water/a roof leak, and it is safe in first aid. Accept short simple sentences. No need to know about the speaker or party yet.

discoveries.text: A blue box is here. A note says: “Keep dry.” Tell your team what you found.

help.ca: Aquí hi ha una caixa blava. Una nota diu: «Manteniu-la seca». Explica al teu equip què has trobat.

discoveries.text: Staff are fixing the leak. Stay outside the blocked passage.

help.ca: El personal està arreglant la gotera. No entreu al passadís tallat.

reveals.text: People checker: describe the sign. Place checker: find that sign on your picture.

help.ca: People checker: descriu el rètol. Place checker: busca aquest rètol a la teva imatge.

reveals.text: Picture checker: what is falling? Message checker: what does the note say to do?

help.ca: Picture checker: què està caient? Message checker: què diu la nota que cal fer?

roleClues.picture-checker: Water is falling from the roof onto the trophy stand. The trophy is getting wet.
roleClues.message-checker: Office note, 9:00: “LEAK above the trophy. Move it somewhere dry. Staff will repair the roof.”
roleClues.people-checker: Chidi: “I moved the trophy to the dry room with the CROSS sign.”
roleClues.place-checker: CROSS = first aid. BOOK = library. BALL = sports hall. ENVELOPE = office. A blue box waits in the dry room.

endingImage.alt: Chidi, wearing green, lifts the star trophy away from dripping water. A blue box waits in the dry first-aid room.

intro.ca: En Chidi ha mogut el trofeu autèntic. L’ha robat o ha ajudat? Descobriu on l’ha portat i per què. Mira la teva imatge. Explica-la al teu equip. Responeu junts.

recap.ca: La copa de l’ànec era falsa. En Chidi va moure el trofeu autèntic abans que arribés l’ànec.

ending.ca: En Chidi ha SALVAT el trofeu d’una gotera! És a la caixa blava de la infermeria. De sobte, el trofeu parla: «Busqueu el SOL». Un trofeu que parla?!

message-checker.ca: Nota de secretaria, 9:00: «GOTERA sobre el trofeu. Porteu-lo a un lloc sec. El personal repararà el sostre».

people-checker.ca: En Chidi: «Vaig portar el trofeu a la sala seca amb el rètol de la CREU».

place-checker.ca: CREU = infermeria. LLIBRE = biblioteca. PILOTA = pavelló. SOBRE = secretaria. Hi ha una caixa blava a la sala seca.

picture-checker.alt: Water is falling from the roof onto the trophy stand. The trophy is getting wet.

message-checker.alt: Office note, 9:00: “LEAK above the trophy. Move it somewhere dry. Staff will repair the roof.”

people-checker.alt: Chidi: “I moved the trophy to the dry room with the CROSS sign.”

chapters.title: 4. The Trophy Talks!
chapters.intro: The trophy is safe. Now it says: “Find the SUN.” Who made it talk? Where should we go? Look at your picture. Tell your team. Answer together.
chapters.recap: Chidi saved the trophy. A voice inside it says: “Find the SUN.” Follow the last clues.
chapters.ending: SURPRISE! Ms Diop put a speaker in the trophy. Her message leads to a school party! Laia’s duck throws confetti. Chidi brings the real trophy. You solved it together!

objectives.text: Where does the message send us? Ask the Picture checker and Place checker. Match the sign. Write the place.

help.ca: On ens envia el missatge? Pregunta al Picture checker i al Place checker. Compara el rètol. Escriu el lloc.

objectives.text: Who put the speaker in the trophy? Ask the Message checker and People checker. Write the name.

help.ca: Qui va posar l’altaveu al trofeu? Pregunta al Message checker i al People checker. Escriu el nom.

objectives.text: Ask in Team chat: “Where shall we go?” Then write together: “Come to… The message is from… It plays through…”

help.ca: Pregunta al xat d’equip: «On anem?» Després escriviu junts: «Vine a… El missatge és de… Sona per…»

objectives.successCriteria: A short invitation naming the courtyard, Ms Diop as the message’s author, and the speaker in the trophy as the source of the voice. Simple A2 phrases are enough. The note already mentions a party; no requirement to guess confetti or other ending-only facts.

discoveries.text: The voice plays again. It sounds exactly the same. Is it a recording? Ask your team.

help.ca: La veu torna a sonar. Sona exactament igual. És una gravació? Pregunta-ho al teu equip.

discoveries.text: You hear music. Something is about to start!

help.ca: Sents música. Alguna cosa està a punt de començar!

reveals.text: Picture checker: say the symbol. Place checker: match it to a place.

help.ca: Picture checker: digues el símbol. Place checker: relaciona’l amb un lloc.

reveals.text: Message checker: who signed the note? People checker: what is that teacher’s name?

help.ca: Message checker: qui ha signat la nota? People checker: com es diu aquesta professora?

roleClues.picture-checker: The voice in the trophy says: “Find the SUN.”
roleClues.message-checker: A note in the trophy base: “I put a small SPEAKER here. It plays my party message. From: the PE teacher.”
roleClues.people-checker: School list: Ms Diop = PE teacher. Laia = student. Chidi = student.
roleClues.place-checker: Event signs: SUN = courtyard. BOOK = library. BALL = sports hall. CROSS = first aid.

endingImage.alt: The star trophy has a speaker in its base. A sun invitation and a duck robot throwing confetti mark a courtyard celebration.

intro.ca: El trofeu està segur. Ara diu: «Busqueu el SOL». Qui l’ha fet parlar? On hem d’anar? Mira la teva imatge. Explica-la al teu equip. Responeu junts.

recap.ca: En Chidi ha salvat el trofeu. Una veu de dins diu: «Busqueu el SOL». Seguiu les últimes pistes.

ending.ca: SORPRESA! La senyora Diop va posar un altaveu al trofeu. El missatge us porta a una festa de l’institut! L’ànec de la Laia llança confeti. En Chidi porta el trofeu autèntic. Ho heu resolt junts!

picture-checker.ca: La veu del trofeu diu: «Busqueu el SOL».

message-checker.ca: Una nota a la base del trofeu: «Hi he posat un petit ALTAVEU. Reprodueix el meu missatge de la festa. De: la professora d’educació física».

people-checker.ca: Llista de l’institut: senyora Diop = professora d’educació física. Laia = alumna. Chidi = alumne.

place-checker.ca: Rètols de l’acte: SOL = pati. LLIBRE = biblioteca. PILOTA = pavelló. CREU = infermeria.

picture-checker.alt: The voice in the trophy says: “Find the SUN.”

message-checker.alt: A note in the trophy base: “I put a small SPEAKER here. It plays my party message. From: the PE teacher.”

people-checker.alt: School list: Ms Diop = PE teacher. Laia = student. Chidi = student.

place-checker.alt: Event signs: SUN = courtyard. BOOK = library. BALL = sports hall. CROSS = first aid.

finale.ca: Cas resolt! El robot de la Laia portava una copa falsa. En Chidi va salvar el trofeu autèntic de l’aigua. La senyora Diop va amagar un missatge de festa al seu altaveu. Heu entès les pistes quan les heu compartit. Digueu al vostre equip: quina sorpresa us ha agradat més?
